title: 1970 Topps #26 Rolf Krueger RC Arizona Cardinals Football
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1970 Topps #26 Rolf Krueger RC Cardinals trading card is a must-have for any vintage football collector. The card features a standard size and is an original, unsigned card manufactured by Topps Co. in the United States. As a rookie card, it is highly sought after and is sure to be a valuable addition to any collection.

The card showcases Krueger, a former player for the St. Louis Cardinals, and is a great piece of memorabilia for any fan of the team or football in general. With its unique design and historical significance, this card is a true gem for any sports trading card enthusiast. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this rare piece to your collection today.
